Hi @BenjaminBossan could you share the exact transformers commit or version you were running when you saw this stack trace, and your torch version as well? I’m testing against the latest transformers main and I am not able to reproduce this error.

Here’s what I see on my side:
```tests/test_decoder_models.py::TestDecoderModels::test_generate_pos_args[AdaLoraConfig-config_kwargs0-hf-internal-testing/tiny-random-Gemma3ForCausalLM] PASSED                                                       [  5%]

tests/test_decoder_models.py::TestDecoderModels::test_generate_pos_args[PrefixTuningConfig-config_kwargs11-hf-internal-testing/tiny-random-Gemma3ForCausalLM] FAILED                                                 [ 66%]
tests/test_decoder_models.py::TestDecoderModels::test_generate_pos_args[PromptEncoderConfig-config_kwargs12-hf-internal-testing/tiny-random-Gemma3ForCausalLM] PASSED                                                [ 72%]
tests/test_decoder_models.py::TestDecoderModels::test_generate_pos_args[PromptTuningConfig-config_kwargs13-hf-internal-testing/tiny-random-Gemma3ForCausalLM] PASSED                                                 [ 77%]
tests/test_decoder_models.py::TestDecoderModels::test_generate_pos_args[ShiraConfig-config_kwargs14-hf-internal-testing/tiny-random-Gemma3ForCausalLM] PASSED                                                        [ 83%]
tests/test_decoder_models.py::TestDecoderModels::test_generate_pos_args[VBLoRAConfig-config_kwargs15-hf-internal-testing/tiny-random-Gemma3ForCausalLM] PASSED                                                       [ 88%]
tests/test_decoder_models.py::TestDecoderModels::test_generate_pos_args[VeraConfig-config_kwargs16-hf-internal-testing/tiny-random-Gemma3ForCausalLM] PASSED                                                         [ 94%]
tests/test_decoder_models.py::TestDecoderModels::test_generate_pos_args[C3AConfig-config_kwargs17-hf-internal-testing/tiny-random-Gemma3ForCausalLM] PASSED                                                          [100%]
```

However, i took the liberty to look around based on your stack trace. Here's what I found:

Based on the provided logs, it is clear that the error is rooted at: `_get_lora_matrices` in `peft/tuners/vblora/layer.py`
```if self.training and vblora_logits_A[0, 0].isinf().any():```

This type of data-dependent branching is not supported by pytorch's dynamo compiler when using `torch.compile()`. Basically, `torch.compile` fails because `_get_lora_matrices` uses a python `if` that depends on tensor data.

I found a similar graph break here: https://thomasjpfan.com/2025/03/pytorch-graphs-three-ways-data-dependent-control-flow/

Typically, we want to use a tensorized control flow like:
```
torch._assert(
        torch.isfinite(vblora_logits_A[0, 0]).all(),
        "Found infinity values in VB-LoRA logits. Ensure training was not resumed from a `save_only_topk_weights` model."
    )
```

or perhaps using `torch.cond`

Once I know your versions, I can try to reproduce your environment more accurately and work on a concrete fix.
